title: In This City, Everyone Can See What You're Thinking. Except Me.
description: In this city your thoughts float above your head. Nobody can lie. My bubble has always been empty… and today the mayor noticed. 😳

scenes.narration: In this city, your thoughts float above your head. Everyone can read them. Nobody can *lie*.
My mom's thought at breakfast: I hope he passes the test. My teacher's: coffee. Now.
Liars get caught in seconds. Crime is zero. Secrets are zero. The city even built a monument to it.
But I have a secret. My bubble has *always* been empty.
Doctors said it's nothing. My mom made me wear a hood. Every day. For twelve years.
Then came the mayor's big speech. Everyone cheered. His bubble said: I love this city.
Zero lies. Zero secrets. That is what makes us safe!
scenes.speaker: mayor

scenes.narration: Then, for one second, his bubble changed. The empty one is here. And he looked *right* at me.
That night, my best friend knocked on my window. And for the first time, *his* bubble was empty too.
There are more of us. Hundreds. The mayor can't read us. And tonight, he's coming for all of us.
scenes.speaker: max

scenes.narration: If I hide, they take my friend. If I go to the square tomorrow, the whole city sees I'm empty. What do I do? Tell me.
